title: scutellaria galericulata subsp. minor
intro: Scutellaria galericulata subsp. minor, commonly known as Chinese Skullcap or Small Leaf Skullcap, is a subspecies of the Scutellaria galericulata plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and anxiety, due to its numerous health benefits such as its ability to reduce stress and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Scutellaria galericulata subsp. minor include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and calm the body and mind. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
